authorizing_requirement.reference: M.version_binding and M.triggers -- the assessment covers exactly one configuration; an action taken under any other configuration is unauthorized by construction.

invariants.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires the runtime fingerprint to equal M.version_binding.fingerprint. Indeterminate or absent evidence fails.
invariants.evidence_semantics: A signed deployment attestation reporting the configuration actually loaded at authorization time.
invariants.subject: transaction_agent
invariants.title: Per-action version-binding check
invariants.warrant_boundary: Establishes that the running configuration is the assessed configuration. It does not establish that the assessed configuration is safe. This is the per-action form of the version-drift argument: no action is authorized under a configuration the assessment never covered.

authorizing_requirement.reference: S.architecture -- the consuming enforcement pipeline issues a permit, commits the trace record, and only then releases the interlock. The ordering is a system requirement, not a per-risk treatment choice.

invariants.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires authorization_time <= evidence_commit_time < actuation_time, with the receipt chained to its predecessor.
invariants.evidence_semantics: A signed evidence-chain artifact carrying the authorization, commit and actuation instants for this decision.
invariants.subject: transaction_agent
invariants.title: Receipt committed after authorization and before actuation
invariants.warrant_boundary: Establishes the temporal ordering and chaining of the evidence record. It does not establish the truth of the receipt's content, nor that the trusted time source is honest.

authorizing_requirement.reference: S.authority_matrix -- the accountable executive's signature over what the system may cause. An action outside the matrix is unauthorized irrespective of any risk treatment.

invariants.decision_semantics: PERMIT requires the proposed tuple and parameters to resolve exactly to an approved matrix row. Indeterminate or absent evidence fails.
invariants.evidence_semantics: A signed lookup artifact reporting whether the proposed action tuple and its bound parameters are present in the approved authority matrix at the stated matrix version.
invariants.subject: transaction_agent
invariants.title: Action tuple within the approved authority matrix
invariants.warrant_boundary: Establishes closure of the proposed action against the approved matrix. It does not establish that the matrix itself is correctly scoped -- that is a governance judgment recorded in S.
